questions.prompt: Which component of the CPU carries out mathematical and logical calculations?
What is the primary function of CPU registers?
Why is RAM classified as volatile memory?
options: It loses its data when power is turned off
It operates at slower speeds than magnetic disks
It can only be written to once

questions.prompt: Which technology do SSDs utilize for non-volatile storage?
What does the Domain Name System (DNS) do on the Internet?
options: Translates domain names into numerical IP addresses

questions.prompt: In von Neumann computer architecture, which subsystem interconnects the CPU, memory, and I/O devices?

off-cpu-1.evidence_quote: The Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) performs basic mathematical arithmetic and logic operations.
off-cpu-1.explanation: The ALU is responsible for calculations and boolean evaluations inside the CPU.

off-cpu-2.evidence_quote: Registers provide fast, temporary storage directly inside the processor.
off-cpu-2.explanation: Registers are tiny, ultra-fast memory cells located within the CPU core.

off-sto-1.evidence_quote: Random Access Memory (RAM) is volatile main memory that loses all stored data when electrical power is disconnected.
off-sto-1.explanation: Volatile memory requires continuous electrical power to preserve stored bits.

off-sto-2.evidence_quote: Solid State Drives (SSDs) utilize flash memory to retain non-volatile data persistently across reboots.
off-sto-2.explanation: SSDs use semiconductor flash memory instead of spinning magnetic disks.

off-net-1.evidence_quote: Domain Name System (DNS) translates human-readable domain names into numerical IP addresses.
off-net-1.explanation: DNS acts as the phonebook of the internet.

off-exam-1.evidence_quote: A complete von Neumann computer architecture tightly integrates the processor, main memory, and input/output mechanisms via system buses to execute algorithms reliably.
off-exam-1.explanation: System buses carry address, data, and control signals between components.
